description: Records the length of the person's foot in millimetres, heel to longest toe. More precise than a shoe they own, and worth asking for when they have no shoes to give or the answer matters. A measurement and owned shoes can both be present.

lengthMm.description: Foot length in millimetres. A typical adult is between 220 and 320.

sessionId.description: The session id returned by start_session. Everything the person tells you is stored against it, and it is the only thing linking one call to the next.

name: set_foot_measurement
title: Record a measured foot length
